critical_code_review_comments: server.py _audience_matches (L7387-7424): clean, defensive normalization handling str/list/None inputs; falls back to 'all' on malformed audience. Good back-compat. One edge case to watch: a list containing 'all' short-circuits to True before filtering by VALID_AUDIENCE_GROUPS, so a payload like ['all','garbage'] still matches everyone — acceptable but consider asserting the filtered list in the creator endpoints (it IS filtered to VALID_AUDIENCE_GROUPS in /announcements/create + /polls/create L7435/L7574 before persistence, so safe).

server.py /polls/create (L7555-7586): max_selections=0 means unlimited and is stored as 0. /polls/list (L7726-7727) still legacy-fallbacks missing max_selections to 1 (not 0). This is correct (legacy single-select polls predate the 0=unlimited semantic), but the asymmetry between 'absent → 1' vs 'explicit 0 → unlimited' is subtle — worth a 1-line comment in /polls/list explaining the distinction so future devs don't 'fix' it to 0.

server.py /polls/list (L7710-7788): per-poll N+1 reads on poll_votes + announcement_states + device_keys for voters_detail. Fine at current scale; add a TODO to batch via $lookup once polls > 100 or voters > 10k.

server.py /polls/list (L7752-7754): is_community computed as `'all' in aud` for list-audience polls — correctly disables voters_detail when audience targets the broad community. Good privacy default. Caveat: a list like ['all','admin'] would still be 'community' (because 'all' overrides) — fine, but worth a comment.

server.py /accounts/list (L6892-6918): now returns ALL device_keys including role='inactive' with is_inactive flag, staff_kind, force_visitor defaults. Good. Hard limit `to_list(length=2000)` — fine for now; add pagination once accounts > 2k.

server.py /ideas/set-state (L7345-7371): gates by role=='creator' OR staff_kind in ('admin','modo'). Note: `state='reset'` clears state via $unset — correct but `state_actor`/`state_by`/`state_at` are also unset, so audit trail is lost. Consider keeping the last actor in a `previous_state_*` field for traceability.
server.py /polls/suggest-option (L7651-7675): no per-user rate limit; a malicious approved device could spam suggestions. Consider 1 pending suggestion per (poll_id, key_id) or a per-hour cap.

server.py /polls/decide-suggestion (L7686-7707): on 'approve' it $push the suggestion text to options — but doesn't dedupe. If the creator approves twice (idempotency check missing on status transition), the option could be pushed twice. Recommend guarding with `if sug['status'] != 'approved'` before $push, OR using $addToSet.
